coverage.summary: Applies statewide to any tenant of residential premises. No unit-count, building-age, construction-date or owner-occupancy limits are stated.

evidence.quoted_span: Any person or agent thereof who threatens to or takes reprisals against any tenant of residential premises
Any person or agent thereof who threatens to or takes reprisals against any tenant of residential premises

result.notes: Section 18 covers any tenant of residential premises and has no building-class limits. The exception for nonpayment-of-rent termination notices limits only when the presumption applies. It is not a building or owner exemption, so it is not listed under unverifiable_exemptions. No document addresses how this rule interacts with local rules, so the preemption and yield fields stay null. The rule is anti-retaliation rather than a just-cause list, as the review note says.
